articles.headline: England's Jarell Quansah suspended for two World Cup matches after Mexico red card
articles.description: England fullback Jarell Quansah has been suspended for two matches after receiving a red card in his side's World Cup round-of-16 win over Mexico.

articles.description: At this summer's World Cup, the U.S. did its homework, aced the quizzes, and then failed the final exam. How should we grade its World Cup?

articles.headline: U.S. star Christian Pulisic suffered microfracture vs. Belgium
articles.description: USMNT and AC Milan attacker Christian Pulisic sustained a bone bruise and microfracture in his lower leg and will be sidelined for several weeks, U.S. Soccer confirmed on Thursday.

articles.headline: Jorge Jesus reaches agreement to become Portugal head coach - sources
articles.description: Jorge Jesus has reached an agreement with Portugal's Football Federation (FPF) to become the next head coach of the national team, sources have told ESPN.
